meta.title: 进来学❗️一镜到底超详细眼神光教程🍂

scenes.context: 一镜到底教你拍出眼神光，道具是一片透光的枫叶。眼神光就是眼中反射的光点，能让眼睛显得有神有生命力。
sentences: 一镜到底教你拍出眼神光。
One take, and I'll teach you real catchlights.
catchlight（眼神光）
道具是一片透光的枫叶。
The prop is a translucent maple leaf.
translucent（透光的）
scenes.speak: One take, and I'll teach you real catchlights. The prop is a translucent maple leaf.

scenes.context: 模特放在阳光下，为眼睛受光做准备。要让眼睛里有光点，前提是模特的脸要朝向有光的方向。
sentences: 模特站在阳光下，眼睛准备受光。
The model stands in sunlight, eyes ready to catch it.
catch light（受光）
scenes.speak: The model stands in sunlight, eyes ready to catch it.

scenes.title_cn: 光源定位：太阳在侧逆光
scenes.context: 太阳在画面一侧，逆光带来高光与眩光。逆光时脸的前景会有强烈的眩光和过曝风险。
sentences: 太阳在画面一侧，带来逆光高光。
The sun sits to one side, giving backlit highlights.
backlight（逆光）
逆光会带来眩光和过曝。
Backlighting brings flare and blown highlights.
flare（眩光）
scenes.speak: The sun sits to one side, giving backlit highlights. Backlighting brings flare and blown highlights.

scenes.title_en: Key Move: Block With Your Hand
scenes.context: 用手挡镜头上方强光，保留眼神光、压住过曝眩光。手挡住直射镜头的光线，既能防止过曝，又能让眼睛里的光点保留下来。
sentences: 用手挡住镜头上方的强光。
Block the harsh light above the lens with a hand.
block（遮挡）
保留眼神光，压住过曝眩光。
Keep the catchlights and tame the blown flare.
tame（压制）
scenes.speak: Block the harsh light above the lens with a hand. Keep the catchlights and tame the blown flare.

scenes.context: 下巴略收，让脸部线条与眼神光更干净。微调角度能让眼里的光点更明显、脸部轮廓更利落。
sentences: 下巴略收，脸部线条更干净。
Tuck the chin for cleaner facial lines.
tuck（收拢）
scenes.speak: Tuck the chin for cleaner facial lines.

scenes.context: 作者连夸漂亮，眼神光与秋叶透光同时成立。透过枫叶的光斑和眼中的高光相呼应，画面氛围感拉满。
sentences: 眼神光与秋叶透光同时成立。
Catchlights and the backlit leaves both work.
backlit（透光的）
scenes.speak: Catchlights and the backlit leaves both work.

practice: The bright spark in the eyes is a catchlight.
Backlighting adds flare and blown highlights.
Block the lens glare with your hand, keep the catchlights.
Tuck the chin to clean up the facial lines.
pitfalls: You get flare and lose the catchlights.
Use a reflector to create catchlights.
Real sun in the eyes beats any bounced light.
A slight chin tuck changes everything.
The model must face the light first.
shifts: 用 catchlight（眼神光）、spark（光点）、lively（有神）
用 backlight（逆光）、flare（眩光）、blown highlights（过曝高光）
